# missing or unreadable file as an empty mapping rather than an error.

column1: # Deliberately still unmapped. Each has a CWE with no counterpart in the
# SinkType vocabulary, and no near-match that would be honest. A wrong
# operation is worse than a null one: the consumer cannot tell it from a right
# one, whereas a null is visibly absent. Extending SinkType is the owner's call.
#   CsvCell  --  CWE-1236 formula injection; no spreadsheet operation in the vocabulary
#   DivisionDenominator  --  CWE-369 divide by zero; not an operation the vocabulary models
#   NetworkDisconnect  --  CWE-772 resource release; no lifecycle operation in the vocabulary
#   MassAssign  --  CWE-915 attribute mass assignment; nearest is validation_bypass (CWE-1287), which is content-type specific
#   ObjectAccessSmell  --  CWE-639/862/863/284 authorization; the vocabulary has no authorization operation
#   SecurityKeyTrustOperation  --  CWE-358/347 signature verification; no verification operation in the vocabulary
#   NetworkBind  --  CWE-200 matches http_response, but binding a socket is not
#     an HTTP response; the CWE agrees and the operation does not
#   ZeroSizeReallocationSink  --  CWE-415 matches double_free, but a zero-size
#     reallocation is not a double free; near in CWE, wrong as an operation
